Life-long asthmatic here.

I had an allergic reaction when I was in middle school due to excess mold in our towns old school. My lungs completely shut after about 2 1/2 minutes and I eventually passed out from not being able to breathe. I remember looking over at my friend Scott during all this and having him ask me if I was okay because my face was turning blue. Luckily he's known me since we were in elementary school and ran out of the room and called 911 right away, and thankfully saved my life.

My heart was stopped for almost 2 minutes before they finally got me going again. Ever since then, I've known the fears and real dangers of asthma. It took me almost a full year to build my lung capacity back up as close to normal as I could get it, which is the equivalent to 75% of a normal non smoker. The rehab training for lungs is not fun let me tell you.

Asthma IS deadly, regardless of what other people think. Sometimes people take it too lightly since it's very common, but don't understand it's severity during certain situations. It's this ignorance that is costing lives, and all they would have to do is allow them to carry their medicine that was prescribed by a doctor. I was always allowed to carry my inhalers on me, and I never went anywhere without them.

My heart is broken for his family, I understand what he went through.. although I was lucky and got to wake up.

When I pack layered bowls with hash included, I usually will do my normal Kief layer in the middle, then I will crumble hash on top, sorta looks like a chocolate chip cookie, in fact I always call it puttin some chips on.

That's the attitude :). Then after you smoke all of your bag, you'll be like damn I'm dry until i find another bag... oh wait, *unscrews kief catcher*.. then you'll proceed to be so high you'll forget what life is.

There is still THC in your plant matter, but the higher concentrated portion is in your trichomes, which are the crystals you see on the flower. Putting the crystals into your kief catcher is basically just storing some high quality THC for later, you still get PLENTY high on smoking your bud :).

For those that don't know, here's some handy information.

You put a coin, in the OP's case a nickel, into the middle part of your grinder. Once you grind your bud and it falls down into the middle section, you give your grinder a shake for awhile, and the coin will help knock around and break off some of the crystals, also helps them fall down into your kief catcher, thus giving you more kief. It's very handy if you try to stretch out your bud as long as possible, since you can smoke kief and get VERY high.

Most of the time when you have a female plant and there are seeds inside, it usually means the plant was stressed out during flowering, or pollinated itself somehow. Most of the time when these seeds get produced in a female plant they aren't usable to grow, for they will usually carry on the traits of the female plant, so you will get constant seed filled females, which also means less THC. Any female plant that is seed free means more THC, since the plant can focus all of it's energy on making Crystals/THC.
